name: Isomorphic Group Substitution (Matrices)
description: I replaced the real-valued functions $f(x)=x$ and $f(x)=-x$ with their isomorphic equivalents in the group of $2 \times 2$ permutation matrices (the identity matrix and the exchange matrix). This preserves the exact mathematical $Z_2$ structure that requires opposite assignments for each pair, but breaks the surface-level text pattern of "inverting polarity" and $f(x)=-x$ that models associate with bipartiteness.
